riskDescription: Risk of incorrect amount being entered in the debit note (IPE-13), leading to inaccurate customer charges or financial misstatements.
controlObjective: To ensure accurate debit notes are issued to customers.
controlActivity: The Manager - Accounts (WHO) checks (WHAT) the details of the debit note (IPE-13) against the interest calculation sheet (IPE-15) received from the TPA Executive (WHERE: supporting documents) for correctness of the amount (HOW) before sending it to the customer for confirmation (WHEN), to ensure accurate debit notes are issued (WHY).
controlEvidence: Debit note (IPE-13), interest calculation sheet (IPE-15), Manager - Accounts' review sign-off.
gapsIdentified: 1. This is a self-review control, which is a weakness; an independent review by another party would enhance control effectiveness. 2. No standardized checklist for Manager - Accounts to ensure all details are verified.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of debit notes (IPE-13) issued. 2. Obtain the corresponding interest calculation sheet (IPE-15). 3. Obtain evidence of Manager - Accounts' review (e.g., sign-off).
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that Manager - Accounts checked the debit note details against the calculation sheet. 2. Recalculate the amount on the debit note and compare it to the calculation sheet. 3. Confirm the correctness of the amount entered in the debit note.

riskDescription: Risk that customer confirmation for debit notes is not obtained, leading to potential disputes or uncollectible amounts.
controlObjective: To ensure that debit notes are acknowledged by customers before being recorded in ERP.
controlActivity: The TPA Executive (WHO) checks (WHAT) for the approved debit note (IPE-13) and confirmation from the customer (WHERE: email/document) before recording the entry in ERP (WHEN), by verifying the presence of both documents (HOW), to ensure that debit notes are acknowledged by customers before being recorded (WHY).
controlEvidence: Approved debit note (IPE-13), customer confirmation (email/document), TPA Executive's review sign-off.
segregationOfDuties: Manager - Accounts obtains confirmation, TPA Executive checks for confirmation.
gapsIdentified: 1. No system-enforced attachment of customer confirmation to the ERP entry for debit notes. 2. The SOP does not define a follow-up process or timeline if customer confirmation is not received promptly.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of debit notes (IPE-13) where entries were recorded in ERP. 2. Obtain the corresponding customer confirmation (email/document). 3. Obtain evidence of TPA Executive's check for confirmation.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that the TPA Executive checked for customer confirmation before recording the entry. 2. Confirm that a valid customer confirmation was obtained for each debit note. 3. Ensure the confirmation matches the debit note details.

riskDescription: Risk that an incorrect ageing report (IPE-18) of receivables is extracted from ERP, leading to inaccurate analysis and ineffective collection strategies.
controlObjective: To ensure the accuracy and completeness of the receivables ageing data.
controlActivity: The TPA Manager (WHO) checks (WHAT) the ageing report (IPE-18) extracted from ERP (WHERE: ERP system) by the TPA Executive (WHO) (HOW) before sharing it with Manager - Accounts and AM – Bid & Auctions (WHEN), to ensure the accuracy and completeness of the receivables ageing data (WHY).
controlEvidence: Ageing Analysis Report (IPE-18), TPA Manager's review sign-off.
segregationOfDuties: TPA Executive extracts report, TPA Manager checks report.
gapsIdentified: 1. No system-generated reconciliation of the ageing report to the General Ledger balance to confirm completeness and accuracy. 2. The SOP does not specify a checklist or criteria for the TPA Manager's review of the report.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of monthly Ageing Analysis Reports (IPE-18). 2. Obtain evidence of TPA Manager's review and sign-off. 3. Obtain the underlying ERP data used to generate the report.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that the TPA Manager extracts and reviews the ageing report monthly. 2. Reconcile the total receivables balance in the report to the General Ledger. 3. Verify the accuracy of ageing buckets for a sample of invoices.

riskDescription: Risk that the action plan (IPE-21) for collection of aged outstanding receivables does not capture all necessary information and steps, leading to ineffective recovery efforts.
controlObjective: To ensure the action plan for aged receivables is comprehensive and effective.
controlActivity: The SM – Strategy & Management (WHO) periodically reviews (WHAT) the action plan (IPE-21) prepared by Manager - Accounts and AM - Bid & Auctions (WHO) (WHERE: action plan document) (HOW) to ensure it captures all necessary information and steps for recovery of aged outstanding receivables (WHY).
controlEvidence: Action plan for outstanding receivables (IPE-21), SM – Strategy & Management's review sign-off.
segregationOfDuties: Manager - Accounts/AM - Bid & Auctions prepare plan, SM – Strategy & Management reviews plan.
gapsIdentified: 1. The term 'periodically reviews' lacks a specific frequency; it should align with the monthly sub-process frequency. 2. No standardized template or checklist for the action plan content to ensure all required information is captured.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of monthly action plans (IPE-21). 2. Obtain evidence of SM – Strategy & Management's review and sign-off. 3. Obtain the ageing report (IPE-18) that informed the action plan.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that SM – Strategy & Management reviewed the action plan. 2. Confirm that the action plan captures all relevant information and steps for recovery. 3. Assess the adequacy of the action plan in addressing aged receivables.

riskDescription: Risk of delay in follow-up or non-completion of follow-up by AM - Bid & Auctions as per the action plan, leading to prolonged outstanding receivables and potential bad debts.
controlObjective: To ensure timely and effective follow-up for collection of aged outstanding receivables.
controlActivity: The Manager - Accounts (WHO) checks (WHAT) that timely follow-up is done by AM – Bid & Auctions (WHO) with customers (WHAT) as per the agreed action plan (IPE-21) (WHERE: action plan, communication records) (HOW) for collection of aged outstanding receivables (WHY).
controlEvidence: Action plan (IPE-21), communication records (emails, call logs), Manager - Accounts' review sign-off.
segregationOfDuties: AM - Bid & Auctions performs follow-up, Manager - Accounts checks timeliness.
gapsIdentified: 1. No system to track follow-up activities and automatically escalate overdue actions as per the action plan. 2. The SOP does not define specific metrics or criteria for 'timely follow-up'.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of monthly action plans (IPE-21). 2. Obtain communication records from AM - Bid & Auctions for selected customers. 3. Obtain evidence of Manager - Accounts' review of timely follow-up.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that Manager - Accounts checked the timeliness of follow-up by AM - Bid & Auctions. 2. Confirm that follow-up actions were performed as per the action plan. 3. Assess the effectiveness of follow-up in recovering outstanding amounts.

riskDescription: Risk that details mentioned in the Note for Approval (NFA) (IPE-19) for non-recoverable amounts are incomplete, leading to inadequate justification for write-offs or provisions.
controlObjective: To ensure completeness and accuracy of reasons for non-recoverable amounts in the NFA.
controlActivity: The Approving Authority (WHO) checks (WHAT) the details mentioned in the Note for Approval (NFA) (IPE-19) prepared by AM - Bid & Auctions (WHO) against supporting documents (HOW) before approval (WHEN), to ensure completeness and accuracy of reasons for non-recoverable amounts (WHY).
controlEvidence: Note for Approval (NFA) (IPE-19), supporting documents for non-recovery, Approving Authority's sign-off.
segregationOfDuties: AM - Bid & Auctions prepares NFA, Approving Authority reviews NFA.
gapsIdentified: 1. No standardized template or checklist for NFA content to ensure all required information is consistently captured. 2. The SOP does not specify the types of 'supporting documents' required for non-recovery.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of NFAs (IPE-19) for non-recoverable amounts. 2. Obtain supporting documents for the reasons mentioned in the NFA. 3. Obtain evidence of Approving Authority's review and approval.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that the Approving Authority checked the details in the NFA. 2. Confirm that all necessary details and supporting documents are present in the NFA. 3. Assess the completeness and accuracy of the reasons for non-recovery.

riskDescription: Risk that reasons for non-recovery are not correctly captured or extensive follow-ups are not performed, leading to inappropriate approval for provisioning.
controlObjective: To ensure that provisions are made only for genuinely non-recoverable amounts after due diligence.
controlActivity: The Approving Authority (WHO) checks (WHAT) the correctness of the reasons mentioned in the NFA (IPE-19) and verifies that extensive follow-ups were performed for recovery (HOW) before providing approval for provisioning (WHEN), to ensure that provisions are made only for genuinely non-recoverable amounts after due diligence (WHY).
controlEvidence: Note for Approval (NFA) (IPE-19), follow-up records, Approving Authority's approval.
segregationOfDuties: AM - Bid & Auctions prepares NFA, Approving Authority reviews and approves.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP does not clearly define what constitutes 'extensive follow-ups' or the required documentation for such efforts. 2. No standardized checklist for the Approving Authority's review to ensure all aspects are covered.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of approved NFAs (IPE-19) for provisioning. 2. Obtain supporting documentation for reasons of non-recovery and evidence of follow-up efforts. 3. Obtain evidence of Approving Authority's review and approval.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that the Approving Authority checked the correctness of reasons and follow-up efforts. 2. Confirm that the reasons for non-recovery are valid and adequately supported. 3. Assess if 'extensive follow-ups' were performed as expected.

riskDescription: Risk that provision for bad debts (IPE-20) is not in line with the existing Bad Debt/Write-off Policy (IPE-22), leading to non-compliance and potential financial misstatement.
controlObjective: To ensure that all provisions for bad debts are in compliance with company policy.
controlActivity: The Director - Finance Control (WHO) cross-checks (WHAT) the provision details (IPE-20) against the Bad Debt/Write-off Policy (IPE-22) (WHERE: policy document) (HOW) while reviewing the request (WHEN), to ensure that all provisions are in compliance with company policy (WHY).
controlEvidence: Provision details (IPE-20), Bad Debt/Write-off Policy (IPE-22), Director - Finance Control's review sign-off.
segregationOfDuties: Approving Authority initiates, Director - Finance Control reviews policy compliance.
gapsIdentified: 1. No system-based policy enforcement or automated checks for compliance of provision details against the policy. 2. The SOP does not specify a checklist for the Director - Finance Control's review to ensure all policy aspects are considered.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of provision details (IPE-20) approved by Director - Finance Control. 2. Obtain the Bad Debt/Write-off Policy (IPE-22). 3. Obtain evidence of Director - Finance Control's review.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that Director - Finance Control reviewed the provision details against the policy. 2. Confirm that the provision amount and rationale comply with the Bad Debt/Write-off Policy. 3. Check for any deviations from policy and their justification.

riskDescription: Risk of unauthorized provision/write-offs being recorded in ERP, leading to fraudulent financial reporting or misstatement of assets.
controlObjective: To prevent unauthorized recording of provisions or write-offs in the ERP system.
controlActivity: The TPA Manager (WHO) checks (WHAT) that the approval (IPE-19) for provision/write-off is as per DoA and is also approved by the Director - Finance Control (WHERE: approval documents) (HOW) before the TPA Executive records entries in ERP (WHEN), to prevent unauthorized recording of provisions or write-offs (WHY).
controlEvidence: Approved NFA (IPE-19), DoA matrix, Director - Finance Control's approval, TPA Manager's review sign-off.
segregationOfDuties: TPA Executive records entry, TPA Manager checks approval, Director - Finance Control approves.
gapsIdentified: 1. No system-enforced DoA for provision/write-off approvals in ERP. 2. The manual check by TPA Manager is prone to human error.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of provision/write-off entries recorded in ERP. 2. Obtain the corresponding approved NFA (IPE-19) and Director - Finance Control's approval. 3. Obtain the DoA matrix and evidence of TPA Manager's check.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that the TPA Manager checked for proper approval before recording. 2. Confirm that the approval is as per DoA and includes Director - Finance Control's sign-off. 3. Ensure the recorded entry matches the approved amount.

riskDescription: Risk of incorrect provision/write-offs being recorded in ERP, leading to misstatement of accounts receivable and bad debt expense.
controlObjective: To ensure accurate recording of provisions/write-offs in the system.
controlActivity: The TPA Manager (WHO) cross-checks (WHAT) the details of the provision (IPE-20) created in ERP (WHERE: ERP system) against the approved provision details (HOW) and provides confirmation to Director - Finance Control & Manager - Accounts (WHEN: after recording), to ensure accurate recording of provisions/write-offs in the system (WHY).
controlEvidence: ERP entries (IPE-10), approved provision details (IPE-20), TPA Manager's confirmation.
segregationOfDuties: TPA Executive records entry, TPA Manager cross-checks details.
gapsIdentified: 1. No automated reconciliation of ERP entries to approved provision details. 2. The SOP does not specify the format or content of the 'confirmation' provided by the TPA Manager.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of provision/write-off entries recorded in ERP. 2. Obtain the approved provision details (IPE-20). 3. Obtain evidence of TPA Manager's cross-check and confirmation.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that the TPA Manager cross-checked the ERP entry against approved details. 2. Confirm that the recorded provision/write-off amount matches the approved amount. 3. Verify that confirmation was provided to Director - Finance Control & Manager - Accounts.

riskDescription: Risk that balance confirmations (IPE-23) are not sent to all customers as appearing in ERP, leading to incomplete confirmation coverage and undetected discrepancies.
controlObjective: To ensure completeness of balance confirmation outreach to all customers.
controlActivity: The SM – Strategy and Management (WHO) checks (WHAT) that balance confirmations (IPE-23) are sent to all customers (WHAT) as appearing in ERP (WHERE: ERP system, communication records) (HOW) at the end of the month/as agreed in PPA (WHEN), to ensure completeness of balance confirmation outreach (WHY).
controlEvidence: List of customers in ERP, sent balance confirmations (IPE-23), SM – Strategy and Management's review sign-off.
segregationOfDuties: AM – Bid & Auctions sends confirmations, SM – Strategy and Management checks completeness.
gapsIdentified: 1. No automated system to track which customers received confirmations and compare against the ERP customer master. 2. The SOP does not specify a detailed procedure or checklist for SM – Strategy and Management's completeness check.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain the customer master list from ERP for the review period. 2. Obtain a list of balance confirmations (IPE-23) sent by AM – Bid & Auctions. 3. Obtain evidence of SM – Strategy and Management's review.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that SM – Strategy and Management checked that confirmations were sent to all customers. 2. Compare the list of customers in ERP with the list of customers to whom confirmations were sent. 3. Identify any customers for whom confirmations were not sent.

riskDescription: Risk that balance confirmation not obtained from all customers, leading to unconfirmed balances and undetected discrepancies.
controlObjective: To ensure a comprehensive follow-up for balance confirmations and identify outstanding confirmations.
controlActivity: The SM – Strategy and Management (WHO) compares (WHAT) the list of confirmations sent (WHERE: communication records) with the confirmations received (WHERE: received documents) on a monthly basis/as agreed in PPA (WHEN), to identify customers from whom confirmations are outstanding (HOW), ensuring a comprehensive follow-up for balance confirmations (WHY).
controlEvidence: List of sent confirmations, received confirmations (IPE-23), SM – Strategy and Management's comparison report/sign-off.
segregationOfDuties: AM – Bid & Auctions obtains confirmations, SM – Strategy and Management compares sent vs. received.
gapsIdentified: 1. No system to track and report outstanding confirmations automatically. 2. The SOP does not define a clear follow-up process for customers from whom confirmations are not received.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain the list of balance confirmations sent (IPE-23). 2. Obtain the list of balance confirmations received. 3. Obtain evidence of SM – Strategy and Management's comparison and identification of outstanding confirmations.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that SM – Strategy and Management performed the comparison of sent vs. received confirmations. 2. Reconcile the sent and received lists to identify outstanding confirmations. 3. Confirm that follow-up actions were initiated for outstanding confirmations.

riskDescription: Risk that incorrect reconciliations are performed by the TPA Executive between customer confirmations and book balances, leading to undetected discrepancies and inaccurate accounts receivable balances.
controlObjective: To ensure accurate reconciliation of customer balances with book balances.
controlActivity: The TPA Manager (WHO) checks (WHAT) for the correctness of the reconciliation statement (IPE-24) prepared by the TPA Executive (WHO) (WHERE: reconciliation statement) against the balance as per ERP (IPE-10) and as confirmed by the customer (IPE-23) (HOW) within 1 day of receiving balance confirmation (WHEN), to ensure accurate reconciliation of customer balances (WHY).
controlEvidence: Reconciliation statement (IPE-24), ERP balance (IPE-10), customer confirmation (IPE-23), TPA Manager's review sign-off.
segregationOfDuties: TPA Executive performs reconciliation, TPA Manager checks correctness.
gapsIdentified: 1. No standardized reconciliation template or automated matching functionality in ERP to assist the TPA Executive. 2. The SOP does not define a clear process for investigating and resolving identified variations in the reconciliation.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of monthly reconciliation statements (IPE-24). 2. Obtain the corresponding ERP balance reports (IPE-10) and customer confirmations (IPE-23). 3. Obtain evidence of TPA Manager's review of the reconciliation.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that the TPA Manager checked the correctness of the reconciliation statement. 2. Reconcile the customer confirmed balance with the ERP book balance. 3. Verify the accuracy of any identified variations and their resolution status.

riskDescription: Risk that write-offs are recorded in an incorrect accounting period, leading to misstatement of financial results.
controlObjective: To ensure write-offs are recognized in the correct accounting period.
controlActivity: The TPA Manager (WHO) checks (WHAT) that write-offs are recorded in the correct period (WHEN/WHY) in the ERP system (WHERE) by reviewing the accounting entries (IPE-10) against available supporting documents (IPE-19) (HOW), on a monthly basis (WHEN).
controlEvidence: Accounting entries (IPE-10), supporting documents (IPE-19), TPA Manager's review sign-off.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP does not specify the exact criteria or checklist for the TPA Manager's review of supporting documents. 2. No mention of independent review of the TPA Manager's check.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of write-off entries from the ERP system (IPE-10) for the review period. 2. Obtain corresponding supporting documents (IPE-19) and the TPA Manager's review evidence. 3. Obtain the Accounts Receivable Write-off Policy (IPE-22).
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that the write-off entries are recorded in the correct accounting period based on the supporting documents. 2. Verify that the TPA Manager's review was performed and documented. 3. Confirm adherence to the Write-off Policy.

riskDescription: Risk that balance confirmations are not sent to all customers, leading to incomplete or inaccurate confirmation of outstanding balances.
controlObjective: To ensure balance confirmations are sent to all customers as per ERP records.
controlActivity: The SM – Strategy and Management (WHO) checks (WHAT) on a monthly basis (WHEN) that balance confirmations (IPE-23) are sent to all customers (WHY) as appearing in the ERP system (WHERE) (HOW).
controlEvidence: List of customers in ERP, sent balance confirmations (IPE-23), SM's review documentation.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP does not specify the method or evidence for the SM – Strategy and Management's check (e.g., system report comparison, sample review). 2. No clear definition of 'all customers' (e.g., based on balance threshold, activity).
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a list of all active customers with outstanding balances from the ERP system for the month. 2. Obtain a sample of sent balance confirmations (IPE-23) and evidence of SM's review.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that balance confirmations were sent to all customers with outstanding balances as per ERP. 2. Verify that the SM – Strategy and Management's review was performed and documented.

riskDescription: Risk that balance confirmations are not obtained from all customers, leading to an incomplete assessment of outstanding balances.
controlObjective: To ensure a high rate of balance confirmation receipt from customers.
controlActivity: The SM – Strategy and Management (WHO) compares (WHAT) the list of confirmations sent (IPE-23) with the confirmations received (IPE-23) on a monthly basis (WHEN) (HOW), to assess the completeness of responses (WHY).
controlEvidence: Sent balance confirmations (IPE-23), received balance confirmations (IPE-23), SM's comparison documentation.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP does not define a target response rate or escalation procedure for low response rates. 2. No mention of alternative procedures for non-responding customers.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain the list of balance confirmations sent (IPE-23) and received (IPE-23) for the month. 2. Obtain evidence of SM's comparison.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that the SM – Strategy and Management performed the comparison between sent and received confirmations. 2. Assess if any follow-up actions were initiated for non-responses (if documented).

riskDescription: Risk that reconciliations between customer confirmations and book balances are performed incorrectly, leading to undetected discrepancies and misstated accounts receivable.
controlObjective: To ensure the accuracy and correctness of balance confirmation reconciliations.
controlActivity: The TPA Manager (WHO) checks (WHAT) for the correctness of the reconciliation statements (IPE-24) prepared by the TPA Executive (WHO) by comparing the balance as per ERP (IPE-10) and as confirmed by the customer (IPE-23) (HOW), on a monthly basis (WHEN), to ensure accurate reconciliation (WHY).
controlEvidence: Reconciliation statement (IPE-24), ERP balance (IPE-10), customer confirmation (IPE-23), TPA Manager's review sign-off.
segregationOfDuties: TPA Executive prepares, TPA Manager reviews.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP does not specify a sampling methodology or threshold for the TPA Manager's check. 2. No mention of documentation requirements for the TPA Manager's review findings.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of reconciliation statements (IPE-24) prepared by the TPA Executive. 2. Obtain corresponding ERP balances (IPE-10) and customer confirmations (IPE-23). 3. Obtain evidence of the TPA Manager's review.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify the mathematical accuracy of the reconciliation statements. 2. Compare reconciled balances with ERP and customer confirmations to ensure correctness. 3. Verify that the TPA Manager's review was performed and documented.

riskDescription: Risk that variations noted during reconciliation are incorrectly calculated or reported, leading to misstatement of accounts receivable or incorrect follow-up actions.
controlObjective: To ensure accurate calculation and reporting of variations in customer balances.
controlActivity: The TPA Manager (WHO) checks (WHAT) on a monthly basis (WHEN) that accurate details of variations (IPE-25) are shared with Manager - Accounts and AM - Bid & Auctions (WHY) for their review (HOW).
controlEvidence: Variation details (IPE-25), reconciliation statement (IPE-24), communication records.
segregationOfDuties: TPA Executive identifies, TPA Manager checks.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP does not specify the method for the TPA Manager's check (e.g., re-calculation, sample review). 2. No clear criteria for what constitutes 'accurate details'.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of variation details (IPE-25) and corresponding reconciliation statements (IPE-24). 2. Obtain evidence of the TPA Manager's check and communication to relevant parties.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify the accuracy of the variations listed in IPE-25 by re-performing calculations or comparing to source data. 2. Verify that the TPA Manager's check was performed and documented.

riskDescription: Risk of delays in following up on aged outstanding balances or failure to follow up, leading to increased bad debt risk and cash flow issues.
controlObjective: To ensure timely and effective follow-up on aged outstanding balances.
controlActivity: The Manager - Accounts (WHO) checks (WHAT) on a monthly basis (WHEN) that timely follow-up is done by AM – Bid & Auctions (WHO) as per the agreed action plan for collection of aged outstanding(s) (HOW), to mitigate collection risk (WHY).
controlEvidence: Action Plan for aged outstanding (IPE-21), communication records with customers, AM – Bid & Auctions' follow-up documentation.
segregationOfDuties: AM – Bid & Auctions performs follow-up, Manager - Accounts reviews.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP does not define what constitutes 'timely' follow-up or specific metrics for assessing effectiveness. 2. No mention of escalation procedures if follow-up is consistently delayed or ineffective.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain the Action Plan for aged outstanding (IPE-21) and related follow-up documentation from AM – Bid & Auctions. 2. Obtain evidence of Manager - Accounts' review.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that follow-up actions were performed by AM – Bid & Auctions according to the action plan and within defined timelines. 2. Verify that Manager - Accounts' review was performed and documented.

riskDescription: Risk that variations in customer balances are approved without proper justification or reasons, leading to unauthorized adjustments or misstatement of accounts.
controlObjective: To ensure that all variations requiring adjustment are properly justified and approved.
controlActivity: The Approving Authority (WHO) checks (WHAT) for the reasons for the variances (HOW) before providing approval (WHEN) for accounting adjustments (WHY), on a monthly basis (WHEN).
controlEvidence: Approved reconciliation statement (IPE-24), variation details (IPE-25), approval documentation.
segregationOfDuties: Manager - Accounts identifies adjustments, Approving Authority approves.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP refers to 'DoA' but does not specify the approval matrix or thresholds for different types/amounts of variations. 2. No explicit requirement for the Approving Authority to document their review of reasons.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of approved reconciliation statements (IPE-24) with variations. 2. Obtain supporting variation details (IPE-25) and evidence of approval from the Approving Authority. 3. Obtain the Delegation of Authority (DoA) matrix.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that approval was obtained from the authorized Approving Authority as per DoA. 2. Verify that reasons for variances were captured and reviewed prior to approval. 3. Confirm that the approval is within the Approving Authority's limits.

riskDescription: Risk of unauthorized or fraudulent entries being recorded in the ERP system, leading to misstatement of financial records or asset misappropriation.
controlObjective: To prevent unauthorized posting of adjustment entries in the ERP system.
controlActivity: Access rights (WHAT) to post entries in the ERP system (WHERE) are restricted (HOW) to authorized personnel only (WHO), on a recurring basis (WHEN - interpreted as continuous/system-enforced), to prevent unauthorized transactions (WHY).
controlEvidence: User access matrix, system access logs, ERP configuration.
financialStatementLineItem: All relevant financial statement line items (e.g., Accounts Receivable, Revenue, Expenses)
segregationOfDuties: Separation of duties between transaction initiation/approval and system access for posting.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP does not specify the process for granting, modifying, or revoking access rights. 2. No mention of periodic review of access rights to ensure they remain appropriate.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain the user access matrix for the ERP system, specifically for posting adjustment entries. 2. Obtain a sample of access provisioning/modification requests. 3. Obtain relevant IT General Controls (ITGC) documentation.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that only authorized personnel have access rights to post adjustment entries in the ERP. 2. Verify that access rights are granted and revoked according to defined procedures. 3. Confirm that access rights are aligned with segregation of duties principles.

riskDescription: Risk that incorrect adjustment entries are recorded in the ERP system, leading to misstatement of accounts receivable.
controlObjective: To ensure the accuracy and correctness of adjustment entries recorded in the ERP system.
controlActivity: The TPA Manager (WHO) cross-checks (WHAT) the details of adjustment entries (IPE-10) created in the ERP system (WHERE) against the approved reconciliation sheet (HOW) on a monthly basis (WHEN), and provides confirmation to Director - Finance Control & Manager - Accounts (WHY), to ensure accuracy.
controlEvidence: Adjustment entry (IPE-10), approved reconciliation sheet (IPE-24), TPA Manager's confirmation.
segregationOfDuties: TPA Executive records, TPA Manager cross-checks.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP does not specify the extent of the cross-check (e.g., 100% review, sample basis). 2. No clear documentation requirement for the TPA Manager's cross-check and confirmation.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of adjustment entries (IPE-10) from the ERP system. 2. Obtain the corresponding approved reconciliation sheets (IPE-24) and evidence of TPA Manager's cross-check and confirmation.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that the adjustment entries in ERP accurately reflect the approved reconciliation sheets. 2. Verify that the TPA Manager's cross-check and confirmation were performed and documented.

riskDescription: Risk that adjustment entries are recorded in an incorrect accounting period, leading to misstatement of financial results.
controlObjective: To ensure adjustment entries are recorded in the correct accounting period.
controlActivity: The TPA Manager (WHO) checks (WHAT) on a monthly basis (WHEN) that adjustments are recorded (IPE-10) in the correct period (WHY) in the ERP system (WHERE) by reviewing available supporting documents (HOW).
controlEvidence: Adjustment entry (IPE-10), supporting documents, TPA Manager's review sign-off.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP does not specify the nature of 'supporting documents' to be reviewed for cut-off. 2. No mention of independent review of the TPA Manager's check.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain a sample of adjustment entries (IPE-10) from the ERP system for period-end. 2. Obtain corresponding supporting documents and evidence of TPA Manager's review.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that adjustment entries are recorded in the correct accounting period based on the supporting documents. 2. Verify that the TPA Manager's review was performed and documented.

riskDescription: Risk that unauthorized, inaccurate, or incomplete customer master records are created in the ERP system, leading to incorrect billing, revenue recognition, or fraud.
controlObjective: To ensure that all new customer master records are authorized, accurate, and complete before creation in the ERP system.
controlActivity: The AM – Bid & Auctions (WHO) initiates a request for new customer code creation (WHAT) by completing a Customer Code Creation Form (IPE-2) and attaching all required documents as per the checklist (IPE-1) (HOW), at the time a new customer relationship is established (WHEN), to ensure only authorized and accurate customer records are created in the ERP system (WHERE) (WHY). The request is then submitted for approval.
controlEvidence: Customer Code Creation Form (IPE-2), Checklist (IPE-1), approval documentation.
segregationOfDuties: Requestor (AM – Bid & Auctions) is separate from the IT Executive who creates the code and the approver.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP does not explicitly state who approves the customer master creation request. 2. No mention of system-enforced mandatory fields or data validation during creation. 3. No periodic review for duplicate or inactive customer codes.

riskDescription: Risk that the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) becomes outdated or irrelevant, leading to non-compliance with current business practices, regulatory requirements, or ineffective controls.
controlObjective: To ensure that SOPs remain current, accurate, and effective.
controlActivity: The Director - Finance Control (WHO) reviews (WHAT) the Accounts Receivable SOP (WHERE) annually (WHEN) to ensure its continued relevance, accuracy, and compliance with internal policies and external regulations (WHY), by comparing it against current processes and regulatory updates (HOW).
controlEvidence: SOP review log, documented review comments, updated SOP version.
gapsIdentified: 1. The SOP does not explicitly state a requirement for periodic review and update of the SOP itself.
todDataValidated: 1. Obtain the latest version of the Accounts Receivable SOP. 2. Obtain evidence of the annual review performed by the Director - Finance Control.
todChecksPerformed: 1. Verify that the SOP has been reviewed within the last 12 months. 2. Verify that review comments and any updates are documented.
